contract.scores: log1p(min ligand component mean_logCP10K * min receptor component mean_logCP10K), all native cells per author unit; expression cooccurrence proxy, not full LIANA consensus scores or binding/flux
contract.scope: Frozen129discovery/87heldout and38eligible author types; full metadata-primary4520LR vocabulary, every position retained in support manifest. Global LRsupport: all ligand components detected>=10percent in at least one available sender AND all receptor components in at least one available receiver within same discovery context, >=ceil129/3 contexts. No heldout or outcome used. All measurable per-context values retained after global filter, including true zero/subthreshold detection.
contract.missing: Unit absent or fewer20cells: entire corresponding sender/receiver slice masked missing. Every retained LR native component required. Diagonal sender=receiver entries retained as within-population interfaces, not demonstrated single-cell autocrine.
contract.scaling: Only one global RMS over observed discovery tensor entries; no per-LR/clinical feature scaling. Exact same scalar for heldout. Noncontext factor columns each unit L2; absorb product of their norms and CP weights into context coefficients. Factor numbering decreasing discovery context column L2, deterministic tie order.
contract.fit: Official Tensorly0.9.0 non_negative_parafac, same core called by cell2cell0.8.0; random init seeds2026101920,2026101921,2026101922 for each rank2..6. Exactly400iterations/tol0, float32 GPU, TF32off, no outcome convergence/seed/rank selection. Retain every15model and choose minimum observed relative reconstruction error per rank. No single selected rank; all20factor clinical slots enter main BH/BY20.
contract.stability: Hungarian match each same-rank restart using mean cosine similarity of four normalized factor axes; report every matched similarity, median>=.8 descriptive stability criterion. No clinical test filtered by stability.
contract.projection: Fixed LR/sender/receiver factors. Per heldout context compute observed NNLS through Gram=(B.T@B)*(U_available.T@U_available)*(V_available.T@V_available), rhs exact scored tensor contraction. Cholesky normal equations converted to scipy NNLS, independent fixture equality required. >=3available author types, positive observed score norm, full Gram rank and sqrt(condition)<1e8. Unidentifiable remains missing. No relearning factors or rank on heldout.
contract.clinical: After all15fits and all20heldout projections saved: original pCR/MPR1 vs nonMPR0; postneoadjuvant surgery association only. Activity=log1p(context coefficient / median positive discovery coefficient), centered/scaled using discovery activity mean/SD only. Continuous activity is model readout; pathology response binary target regressor. Main covariates original8clinical + canonical agent fixed effects + log1p all immune cells + all-cell meanlogRNA/meanloggenes + sender/receiver factor-L1-weighted state fractions of all source immune cells. Complete nuisance column space retained and rank/span reported; no outcome/clinical P variable selection.
contract.clinical_gates: At least50complete author records, >=10each response, >=10residual df, target identifiable, nuisance and complete design stable/condition<1e8/leverage<.999999. Heldout87nonoutcome profile blocks eachsingleton; no reviewed independent-patient alias assertion. If future non-singleton block discovered, stop before clinical inference rather than sample-level randomization.
contract.statistics: Reuse previously independently accepted NSCLC cohort HC3 restricted-null Rademacher wild t,19999draws; two-sided add-one P. Fixed2000within cancer x canonical agent resamples, report valid; percentile CI only if>=1900valid, no resampling until desired result. All20main slots BH and BY with unestimable P=1 included. Fixed500seedoffsets defined in code/hash; no seed search. Full random vectors persisted privately for independent replay.
contract.sensitivity: All20unadjusted group contrasts, original8+agent clinical-only, clinical+RNA/count without factor abundance: point effect and asymptotic HC3 CI only, no extra significance selection. All20unadjusted two-sided Mann-Whitney U (Wilcoxon rank-sum) with tie/asymptotic correction, separate BH/BY20 as secondary only. Leave-one-author-record main effects; no claim independent-patient leaveout.
contract.limits: Source previously explored; heldout is separation of model learning, not untouched external validation. Immune-only labels are original author subtypes, not new unified formal states. Distinct from 2026 October9CM and 2026-10-18 RNA MCP. Original closed clinical/function families not reopened. No direct interaction, resistance mechanism or baseline prediction claim.
